dialogue.speaker: Skyler
dialogue.source_text: Walt. I've said it before. If you are in danger, we go to the police.
dialogue.amharic: ዋልት። ቀደም ብዬ ነግሬሃለሁ። አደጋ ላይ ከሆንክ፣ ወደ ፖሊስ እንሄዳለን።

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: Oh, no. I don't want to hear about the police.
dialogue.amharic: ኦ፣ አይ። ስለ ፖሊስ ማዳመጥ አልፈልግም።

dialogue.speaker: Skyler
dialogue.source_text: I do not say that lightly. I know what it could do to this family.
dialogue.amharic: ያንን በቀላሉ አልናገርም። ለዚህ ቤተሰብ ምን ሊያደርግ እንደሚችል አውቃለሁ።

dialogue.speaker: Skyler
dialogue.source_text: But if it's the only real choice we have--
dialogue.amharic: ግን ብቸኛው እውነተኛ ምርጫችን ከሆነ--

dialogue.speaker: Skyler
dialogue.source_text: If it's either that-- Oh... or your getting shot when you open your front door--
dialogue.amharic: ያ ካልሆነ-- ኦ... ወይም የፊት በርህን ስትከፍት በጥይት ከተመታህ--

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: I don't want to hear about the police.
dialogue.amharic: ስለ ፖሊስ ማዳመጥ አልፈልግም።

dialogue.speaker: Skyler
dialogue.source_text: You're not some hardened criminal, Walt.
dialogue.amharic: አንተ የሰለጠነ ወንጀለኛ አይደለህም፣ ዋልት።

dialogue.speaker: Skyler
dialogue.source_text: You're in over your head. That's what we tell them. That's the truth.
dialogue.amharic: ከራስህ በላይ ሆነሃል። ለእነሱ የምንነግራቸው ያንን ነው። እውነቱ ያ ነው።

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: That is not the truth.
dialogue.amharic: ያ እውነት አይደለም።

dialogue.speaker: Skyler
dialogue.source_text: Of course it is. A schoolteacher, cancer, desperate for money?
dialogue.amharic: በእርግጥ ነው። አስተማሪ፣ ካንሰር፣ ለገንዘብ የተጣራ?

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: Okay, we're done here.
dialogue.amharic: እሺ፣ ጨርሰናል።

dialogue.speaker: Skyler
dialogue.source_text: Roped into working for-- Unable to even quit?
dialogue.amharic: ለ-- እንድትሰራ ተጠልፈሃል? ማቆም እንኳ አትችልም?

dialogue.speaker: Skyler
dialogue.source_text: You told me that yourself, Walt.
dialogue.amharic: ራስህ ነግረኸኛል፣ ዋልት።

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: Jesus, what was I thinking?
dialogue.amharic: ኢየሱስ፣ ምን ነበር ያሰብኩት?

dialogue.speaker: Skyler
dialogue.source_text: Walt, please. Let's both of us stop trying to justify this whole thing
dialogue.amharic: ዋልት፣ እባክህ። ሁለታችንም ይህን ሁሉ ለማ justification መሞከር እናቁም

dialogue.speaker: Skyler
dialogue.source_text: and admit you're in danger.
dialogue.amharic: እና አደጋ ላይ መሆንህን አምን።

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: Who are you talking to right now? Who is it you think you see?
dialogue.amharic: አሁን ከማን ጋር ነው የምትናገሪው? ማን እንደሆንኩ ነው የምታስቢው?

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: Do you know how much I make a year?
dialogue.amharic: በዓመት ስንት እንደማገኝ ታውቂያለሽ?

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: I mean, even if I told you, you wouldn't believe it.
dialogue.amharic: ማለቴ፣ ብነግርሽም እንኳ አታምኚም።

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: Do you know what would happen if I suddenly decided to stop going in to work?
dialogue.amharic: በድንገት ወደ ስራ መሄድ ብቀጥል ምን እንደሚሆን ታውቂያለሽ?

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: A business big enough that it could be listed on the NASDAQ
dialogue.amharic: በNASDAQ ሊዘረዘር የሚችል ትልቅ ንግድ

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: goes belly-up, disappears. It ceases to exist without me. No.
dialogue.amharic: ወድቆ ይጠፋል። ያለእኔ መኖር ያቆማል። አይ።

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: You clearly don't know who you're talking to, so let me clue you in.
dialogue.amharic: ከማን ጋር እንደምትናገሪ በግልጽ አታውቂም፣ ስለዚህ ልንገርሽ።

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: I am not in danger, Skyler. I am the danger.
dialogue.amharic: እኔ አደጋ ላይ አይደለሁም፣ ስካይለር። እኔ አደጋው ነኝ።

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: A guy opens his door and gets shot, and you think that of me?
dialogue.amharic: አንድ ሰው በሩን ከፍቶ በጥይት ይመታል፣ እና አንቺ ያንን ስለ እኔ ታስቢያለሽ?

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: No. I am the one who knocks.
dialogue.amharic: አይ። በሩን የሚያንኳኳው እኔ ነኝ።
